reason: Resolves perl-lsp.autoPopulateNewFiles against each created file's own workspace folder (#14547). The file-creation handler moves out of the activate() closure into the exported populateCreatedFiles, and the per-URI getConfiguration call plus its explanatory comments grow the bundled out/extension.js from 1615152 to 1616282 bytes. The measured 29-file package is size-only: the inventory records no file additions and no removals. It makes no claim about file permissions, which this instrument does not model -- it compares presence and size alone.
